description: 200,479 historical wildfire incident locations recorded by the BC Wildfire Service, with cause, year, size and response. Published by BC Wildfire Service (Province of British Columbia) as [BC Wildfire Fire Incident Locations - Historical](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/bc-wildfire-fire-incident-locations-historical) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: FIRE_NUMBER
table:columns.description: A composite of the following fields: Zone, Fire ID and Fire Centre.

table:columns.name: FIRE_YEAR
table:columns.description: Represents the fiscal year, April 1 to March 31.

table:columns.name: RESPONSE_TYPE_DESC
table:columns.description: Describes the type of response an incident is receiving and is based on fire behaviour, potential risks and environmental factors.

table:columns.name: IGNITION_DATE
table:columns.description: The discovery date of the fire.

table:columns.name: FIRE_OUT_DATE
table:columns.description: The date the fire is deemed out.

table:columns.name: FIRE_CAUSE
table:columns.description: The suspected cause of the fire, e.g., Lightning, Person.

table:columns.name: FIRE_LABEL
table:columns.description: The concatenation of Fire Number and Fire Year.

table:columns.name: FIRE_CENTRE
table:columns.description: Represents the BC Wildfire Service Centre administrative area.

table:columns.name: ZONE
table:columns.description: A subset of the BC Wildfire Service Centre administrative area.

table:columns.name: FIRE_ID
table:columns.description: A unique number, system-generated, within a fire year and fire centre.

table:columns.name: FIRE_TYPE
table:columns.description: Defines the type of incident that occurred, e.g., Fire, Nuisance Fire, Smoke Chase.

table:columns.name: INCIDENT_NAME
table:columns.description: The official name of the wildfire.

table:columns.name: GEOGRAPHIC_DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: A description of the approximate fire location: IC must note how far and in what direction the wildfire is in relation to a geographic reference. Note: for Railroad fires, actual railroad mileage is iuncluded as part of the geographic information, e.g., Sallus Creek, 172 mile-marker on railroad.

table:columns.name: CURRENT_SIZE
table:columns.description: The estimated size of the area within the outside perimeter of the incident, in hectares.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_CODE
table:columns.description: Contains an alphanumeric value based on the Canadian Council of Surveys and Mappingâ€™s (CCSM) system for classification of geographic features, e.g., AR82000110.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: A column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: A binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

title: BC Wildfire Fire Incident Locations - Historical
